title: The homotopy type of the clique complex of the partition graph
summary: For each positive integer $n$, let $G_n$ be the graph whose vertices are the partitions of $n$, with edges corresponding to elementary transfers of one cell between two parts, followed by reordering. Let $K_n := \mathrm{Cl}(G_n)$ be the clique complex of $G_n$. We prove that $K_n$ is homotopy equivalent to a wedge of $2$-spheres. More precisely, $K_n$ is homotopy equivalent to a wedge of $b_n$ copies of $S^2$, where $b_n = χ(K_n) - 1$. Thus the homotopy type of $K_n$ is completely determined by its Euler characteristic.
